webster.text: Very miserable; involved in deep distress; oppressed with infelicity; wretched from misfortune; applied to men.

more.text: Producing distress and misery; making wretched; applied to external circumstances; as a calamitous event.
Full of misery; distressful; wretched; applied to state or condition.

example.quote: The internal effects of a mutable policy are still more calamitous.
